tours.name: Add or Correct an Attendance Record Manually

name_i18n.en_US: Add or Correct an Attendance Record Manually

tours.description: Learn how HR creates an attendance record by hand when an employee forgot to check in or out, choosing the employee and the exact check-in and check-out times, then saving the correction.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how HR creates an attendance record by hand when an employee forgot to check in or out, choosing the employee and the exact check-in and check-out times, then saving the correction.

steps.title: Open Attendances
steps.description: The Attendances app keeps the check-in and check-out times of every employee. HR administrators can add or correct these records when someone forgets to check in or out.

description_i18n.en_US: The Attendances app keeps the check-in and check-out times of every employee. HR administrators can add or correct these records when someone forgets to check in or out.

steps.title: Switch to List
steps.content: Click List to see the records as a table.

content_i18n.en_US: Click List to see the records as a table.

steps.description: The list view is the easiest place to add or edit records, and it shows the employee, check-in, check-out and worked hours of each entry.

description_i18n.en_US: The list view is the easiest place to add or edit records, and it shows the employee, check-in, check-out and worked hours of each entry.

steps.title: New record
steps.content: Click New to add an attendance record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to add an attendance record.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank attendance record. Use it when the employee has no entry for the day, for example because the kiosk was not used.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank attendance record. Use it when the employee has no entry for the day, for example because the kiosk was not used.

steps.title: Employee
steps.content: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

steps.description: The record is saved against one employee. Opening the field shows the employees you can choose from. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

description_i18n.en_US: The record is saved against one employee. Opening the field shows the employees you can choose from. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

steps.validation_message: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

validation_message_i18n.en_US: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

steps.title: Choose the employee
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the employee who forgot to check in or out. You can also type part of the name to narrow down the list.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the employee who forgot to check in or out. You can also type part of the name to narrow down the list.

steps.title: Check-in time
steps.content: Click the check-in field to open the calendar.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the check-in field to open the calendar.

steps.description: The check-in field holds the date and time the employee started work. It is filled with the current time, so open the calendar to change it to the correct day.

description_i18n.en_US: The check-in field holds the date and time the employee started work. It is filled with the current time, so open the calendar to change it to the correct day.

steps.title: Pick the check-in day
steps.content: Click the day the employee started work.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the day the employee started work.

steps.description: Click the correct day in the calendar. The time of day can be changed in the same calendar before you confirm.

description_i18n.en_US: Click the correct day in the calendar. The time of day can be changed in the same calendar before you confirm.

steps.title: Apply check-in
steps.content: Click Apply to confirm the check-in.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Apply to confirm the check-in.

steps.description: Apply confirms the check-in date and time and closes the calendar. The field now shows the corrected value.

description_i18n.en_US: Apply confirms the check-in date and time and closes the calendar. The field now shows the corrected value.

steps.title: Check-out time
steps.content: Click the check-out field to open the calendar.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the check-out field to open the calendar.

steps.description: The check-out field holds the time the employee finished work. It stays empty while the employee is still checked in, so fill it in to close the record.

description_i18n.en_US: The check-out field holds the time the employee finished work. It stays empty while the employee is still checked in, so fill it in to close the record.

steps.title: Pick the check-out day
steps.content: Click the day the employee finished work.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the day the employee finished work.

steps.description: The check-out must be later than the check-in, otherwise Odoo refuses to save the record. Pick the day and, if needed, the time.

description_i18n.en_US: The check-out must be later than the check-in, otherwise Odoo refuses to save the record. Pick the day and, if needed, the time.

steps.title: Apply check-out
steps.content: Click Apply to confirm the check-out.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Apply to confirm the check-out.

steps.description: Apply confirms the check-out and closes the calendar. Odoo now calculates the worked hours from the two times.

description_i18n.en_US: Apply confirms the check-out and closes the calendar. Odoo now calculates the worked hours from the two times.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the record.

steps.description: Saving stores the manual attendance record. It now counts in worked hours, overtime and attendance reports.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving stores the manual attendance record. It now counts in worked hours, overtime and attendance reports.

steps.title: Worked hours
steps.content: Check the worked hours, then click them to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Check the worked hours, then click them to finish.

steps.description: Worked Hours is calculated from the check-in and check-out you entered. If the figure looks wrong, correct the times and save again.

description_i18n.en_US: Worked Hours is calculated from the check-in and check-out you entered. If the figure looks wrong, correct the times and save again.
